row.notes: In Game_ChampionshipGameMode_BuildSessionSettings (0x1407b7b90): movzx eax,byte [rdi+0x278] (7 bytes) right after mov rdx,[r13+0x1448]. rdi = the current weekend (vt_Career_Weekend: the season from game+0x1030 vt+0x88, weekends +0x288, index +0x2a0), eax = its track stat id (Weekend+0x278), rdx = the mode's TrackDataSystem (item vector +0x28..+0x30, 16 bytes per stat id, TrackDataRecord at +8), r13 = the championship game mode. The next instructions leave r12 = the record, 0 when the stat id is >= the item count (jbe) or the item is null, store it at SessionSettings+0x30 and pass it as rdx to 0x1407a1310, whose loop calls 0x142e57e90 that reads [record+0x78] (0x142e57efb) (the track name, for the FILENAME key) with no check. Steam 1.0.145 (0x1407b7e16, fn 0x1407b7bd0) bundles of 2026-11-17/18: ACCESS_VIOLATION reading 0x78 at F1_25.exe+0x2e5a48b (fn 0x2e5a420+0x6b < 0x7a140e < 0x7b7e78) on a Driver Career race load whose weekend track is 36 (the suzuka24 slot, filled only by an imported track that was uninstalled). A second read of the same weekend's track later in the function (mov rdx,[r13+0x1448] at 0x1407b8be4) checks the record and bails. Pattern unique in .xtls on Steam 1.0.141 (match 0x1407b7dcf) and 1.0.145 (.tls$, 0x1407b7e0f) and in the EA 1.0.141 (.rdata, 0x1407b6edf) and 1.0.145 (.arch, 0x1407b6f1f) dumps.
